concerns.text: FR-001 (compute reduced inertia tensor for every FoF halo) has no concrete implementation task; T012 only defines a stub that raises NotImplementedError and no downstream task verifies full computation.

FR-004 (non‑parametric statistical testing) is not realized: T023b describes the test but no verification task produces `data/processed/binning_tests.csv` and the analyze report flags it as uncovered.

FR-007 (repeat full analysis on Millennium‑II) lacks a complete processing pipeline; only T029 attempts download and T031 logs a gap, but no ingestion, shape computation, or statistical analysis tasks for Millennium‑II are present.

FR-008 (associational_only flag in all outputs) is referenced in T005/T026a but there is no verification task ensuring every generated CSV/JSON/MD includes the flag; T047 scans for the flag but earlier tasks do not guarantee its presence.

FR-011 (linear regression of galaxy property ~ shape parameters controlling for halo mass) is missing: T023a is absent from the task list, and the analyze report notes the regression results file is not produced.
SC-001 (Spearman correlation between halo triaxiality and SFR) has no dedicated task or test; no output file or unit‑test computes or validates this correlation.
SC-002 (Kruskal‑Wallis p‑value) is not measured because T023b (which should generate the Kruskal‑Wallis result) is missing.
SC-003 (sensitivity‑analysis variance or rank‑order preservation) lacks a concrete verification task; T032‑VerifySC003 is described but no test file (`test_sc003_metric`) is present.
SC-004 (reproducibility metric between TNG‑100 and Millennium‑II) is not addressed; no task computes or reports the correlation‑coefficient comparison across datasets.
SC-006 (misalignment angle correlation significance) is implied by T039 regression, but there is no explicit test or output validating the null‑hypothesis check for the misalignment analysis.
The data model defines a Null Control Record entity, yet no task creates `data/processed/null_control_results.csv` or equivalent; the pipeline lacks a null‑simulation step.

Phase 5 (Orientation Misalignment Analysis) lists tasks T035‑T040, but T035 (unit test for angle calculation) and T036‑T039 are present while T040 only appends a markdown section; there is no task that verifies the statistical significance of the misalignment regression beyond the regression itself.

The contracts (`analysis_result_schema.schema.yaml` and `halo_schema.schema.yaml`) require output files to conform to schemas, yet tasks for schema validation (e.g., unit tests asserting schema compliance for all generated CSVs) are missing for several outputs (e.g., `null_control_results.csv`).
The quickstart documentation is created (T002, T041) but no task verifies that the quickstart actually runs the full pipeline end‑to‑end on a sample dataset.
Task T023a is referenced in the plan but does not exist in the tasks list; this stale reference leaves FR‑011 uncovered.
Task T023b is referenced in the plan but is not present in the tasks list; this stale reference leaves FR‑004 uncovered.
